# Leaflet 1.9.4

Pinned stable release, served locally for the Gallery map view.

- Project and documentation: https://leafletjs.com/
- Distribution: https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/
- License: BSD-2-Clause, included in `LICENSE`
- JavaScript SHA-256 (base64): `20nQCchB9co0qIjJZRGuk2/Z9VM+kNiyxNV1lvTlZBo=`
- CSS SHA-256 (base64): `p4NxAoJBhIIN+hmNHrzRCf9tD/miZyoHS5obTRR9BMY=`

Map tiles are fetched only when a visitor opens the Map view. The default tile
layer is OpenStreetMap Standard and displays its required attribution. See
https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/ for the tile service policy.
